ImageDescription.value:
Honey milk bread
650g plain strong flour
300g warm milk and ~100g warm water
75g margarine
quick acting yeast
tbsp honey
2 tsp salt
Mix dry ingredients with margarine. Dissolve honey in warmed milk, and knead into mix for 10 minutes adding water as necessary to make a soft dough. 40 minute to 1 hour prove until doubled in size, then 40 to 60 minutes at 200 C, depending on oven.
